name: Drop Kick
description: A quick standing attack. Counters High Risk and Mad Rush moves.

name: Body Slam
description: A powerful standing move. Counters Mad Rush moves.

name: Back Elbow
description: A sharp counter from close range. Counters Behind Opponent moves.

name: Russian Leg Sweep
description: Takes the opponent down. Counters Behind Opponent and Back To Foe moves.

name: Jawbreaker
description: A sudden escape that counters Victim Below moves.

name: Knee Lift
description: A heavy strike. Counters Arm Extended moves.

name: Neckbreaker
description: A high-impact head attack from close range.

name: Vertical Suplex
description: A high-impact throw. Counters In Close moves.

name: DDT
description: Drives the opponent down. Counters Head Down moves.

name: Dragon Sleeper
description: A grounded submission that drains momentum while maintained.

name: Clothesline
description: A charging strike that creates a Mad Rush position.

name: Elbow Drop
description: A grounded follow-up that leaves the opponent below you.
